deterministic_discovery.notes: Discovery is deterministic for well-formed Python AST. Silently skips some Python 3.12+ syntax patterns (F007).

deterministic_identity.notes: Canonical IDs derived from stable semantic fields, not mutmut keys. Same revision+mutation => same ID.

process_isolation.notes: Each execution runs in isolated workspace with explicit cwd/PYTHONPATH/env. Process group killed on timeout.

resume.notes: No native resume. Workaround: shard-based recovery (M44.20). Completed shards are not re-executed.

cache_correctness.notes: ClariFin_OS owns canonical cache (M44.12). mutmut .mutmut-cache is ignored for results; only used as discovery hint.

timeout_isolation.notes: Per-execution timeout enforced via subprocess.communicate(timeout). Process group terminated cleanly on expiry.

result_normalization.notes: Exit codes mapped to 10 canonical MutationResultState values. Tool crashes NEVER map to SURVIVED or KILLED.

ci_operation.notes: Identical execution locally and in CI (same .venv, same PYTHONPATH resolution per env.py).

src_import_correctness.notes: PYTHONPATH explicitly set to workspace/src before site-packages. Correctness gate (M44.15) verifies mutated source is actually imported.

parallel_execution.notes: Orchestrator controls parallelism via ThreadPoolExecutor with per-worker isolation. Workers never share mutable state.

failure_diagnostics.notes: Every infrastructure failure classified with InfrastructureFailureKind. Diagnostics endpoint available.

evidence_provenance.notes: Each execution record contains execution_id, campaign_id, mutant_id, worker_id, timing, and output refs.

large_campaign_support.notes: Sharding (M44.20) + persistence (M44.10) enable campaigns of arbitrary size. Each shard completes within timeout.

known_limitations.description: Silent mutation skipping for some Python 3.12+ syntax (F007)
known_limitations.impact: Undercount of generated mutants for affected files
known_limitations.mitigation: Cross-reference with static analysis estimate; flag discrepancies

known_limitations.impact: Full campaigns cannot resume from interruption point
known_limitations.mitigation: Shard-based recovery: each shard is independent and resumable

known_limitations.description: Parallel execution may contend on ports (F010)
known_limitations.impact: Intermittent failures with --max-children > 1 for tests that bind ports
known_limitations.mitigation: Isolated workspaces prevent most contention; port-binding tests should use serial execution

architectural_decision: Mutmut retained as production backend (Option A) with strict adapter boundary. The adapter enforces all required criteria. Limitations are documented and mitigated. If a superior backend becomes available, replacement requires only implementing MutationBackendBase — no downstream changes needed.
